text: Every time I sneeze, I swap places with a random stranger. And they land at my school desk.
And today, the pollen count was the highest in history.
My name is Max. It started in the middle of a math test.
Achoo! Suddenly I was in a pizza shop, with dough flying over my head.
And the pizza chef? He was sitting at my desk, staring at my math test.
Achoo! Now I was a goalkeeper, in a giant stadium, with fifty thousand people screaming.
The ball flew straight at my face. I sneezed again.
Achoo! I was in the zoo. Inside the lion cage. Holding a bucket of meat.
The lion looked at me. I looked at the lion. The zookeeper was now in my math class.
Achoo! A wedding. Everyone was staring at me. I was holding the ring.
Achoo! A fire truck. And I was driving it. I'm eleven!
Then came the biggest sneeze of my life.
I opened my eyes in the cockpit of a plane, high above the clouds.
And the pilot? He was in my classroom, doing long division.
The plane started to dive. Alarms everywhere. I needed one more sneeze. But nothing came.
I searched everywhere. Then I found it. The pilot's lunch. A pepper sandwich.
I took one big sniff. Achoo!
The pilot was back in the sky. And I was back at my desk.
My whole class was clapping.
The teacher handed back my test. A plus. Perfect score.
Because a chef, a goalkeeper, a zookeeper, and a pilot had each solved one question.
The doctor says I'll grow out of it.
But tomorrow is the math final.
So tonight, I'm buying pepper.
